scope: Implementation worklist only. Native source routes and known operand numbers do not qualify Wasm lowering or callable values.

slots.name: CCL::=-2
required_work: Target numeric equality including boxed operands and condition paths; preserve the fallback dependencies.

slots.name: CCL::>-2
required_work: Target numeric ordering including boxed operands and condition paths; preserve the fallback dependencies.

slots.name: CCL::<-2
required_work: Target numeric ordering including boxed operands and condition paths; preserve the fallback dependencies.

slots.name: COMMON-LISP::EQL
required_work: D1-aware EQL including boxed numbers; use EQ only under a qualified target type proof.
Classify recursion, roots, safepoints and all supported object representations; no host-layout shortcut.

slots.name: COMMON-LISP::LENGTH
required_work: D1 NIL, lists, simple vectors and vector headers; preserve slow-path and condition dependencies.
Qualify traversal safepoints, roots and overflow behavior, including malformed list paths.

slots.name: CCL::SEQUENCE-TYPE
required_work: D1 sequence classification, including NIL, specialized vectors and vector headers, with its fallback and condition paths.

slots.name: CCL::%AREF1
required_work: Target vector indexing, bounds, element representations, displacement and fallback/condition dependencies.

slots.name: CCL::%ASET1
required_work: Target vector stores and bounds, element conversion and fallback/condition dependencies.
Classify every store's GC role and required write barrier before lowering or removing it.
